title: Pricing Desk Rule: Renewal Rate for a Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal Accepted by Contract End
content:
**Rule.** The standard renewal rate for a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement whose renewal offer is accepted on or before the contract end date is the renewal rate stated in the final options notice on the agreement, rounded half up to the cent per kWh.

## How the rate is put together

- **Starting rate.** The renewal rate stated in the final options notice on the agreement, in cents per kWh. Where more than one final options notice is on record, the one with the latest notice date is read.
- **Adjustment.** Any amounts in cents per kWh taken off or added to the rate are first summed into one adjustment, and that adjustment is applied once to the starting rate.
- **Rounding.** The rate is rounded half up to the cent per kWh only at the end.
- **Dates.** The contract end date is read from the agreement record.

## Hypothetical worked example

The final options notice on a hypothetical agreement states a renewal rate of 8.95 cents per kWh. The starting rate is 8.95; the renewal rate, rounded half up to the cent per kWh at the end, is 8.95 cents per kWh.

## Rounding at the end, illustrated

A hypothetical assembled figure of 9.124 cents per kWh is rounded to 9.12; one of 9.125 is rounded to 9.13. Rounding is applied once, to the assembled figure, never to a part of it.
